name: Alai
description:
Alai is an AI presentation designer that turns your content into polished, on-brand slides. With the Alai connector, Claude can build and edit real decks for you — no copy-pasting into another tool.

What you can do:
- Generate a full presentation from a prompt, notes, research, or any document
- Add or remove individual slides in an existing deck
- Apply your team's themes and "vibes" (visual style presets) so every deck stays on brand
- Generate speaker notes and transcripts for a finished deck
- Export to PowerPoint (.pptx), PDF, or a shareable link
- Browse and manage the presentations already in your Alai workspace

Every deck Alai produces is fully editable in the Alai app — real text, layouts, and images, not flat pictures of slides — so you can hand it off, refine it with a prompt, or adjust it by hand.

Alai is built for anyone who lives in slides: founders raising a round, sales teams building customer decks, marketers producing content, and educators making lesson material.

Requires a free Alai account at app.getalai.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Alai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Alai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://slides-api.getalai.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Alai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Alai provides these MCP tools: create_slide, delete_presentation, delete_slide, export_presentation, generate_presentation, generate_transcripts, get_generation_status, get_presentations, get_themes, get_vibes, and ping.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Alai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Alai in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Alai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Alai is developed by Alai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
